title: I'm building Shatterwake: Ascension - an AI Native DnD Sandbox MMO
author: Olmeca_Gold
selftext:
Hey,

I've been building Shatterwake for a while. 2 years in preproduction, 4 months full production essentially since Fable. Yesterday I released its [announcement trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h5ohVj3lseU). It didn't do well on Twitter and I didn't do outreach for it yet. But I'll have many more videos.

Shatterwake uses AI toward groundbreaking game features. 

- 80 DnD mechanics elevated with AI
- Generative crafting and building (imagine & craft/build your own structures and gear)
- Personalized questline that adapts to your actions.
- Smart gods watching over your deeds.
- Smart NPCs & companions.
- Renowned player lore influences the game.

And more features trying to create essentially the most emergent MMORPG ever.

I'm also building with an agent swarm studio structure. You can watch my orchestrators build the game live. I'm super excited about this feature as well. Taking "building in public" to the next level.

https://shatterwakeascension.com/live-dev/

Hope this is interesting. If so, feel free to check the website, hop on discord, get in touch. I'm trying to grow a community to hopefully be able to fundraise for it. 

All questions welcome.

Thanks for reading!
